sketchMechanisms: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil, so the entire expression evaluates to nothing without error.
A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right, filling unmatched columns with NULL.
In Elixir, a process that is linked to another via Process.link will die when the other process dies — unless it traps exits, which converts death into a message it must carry.
